Friend, Today marks a year of devastation, of slaughter, of brokenness for so many of us. With support from the United States, Israel’s government has killed 16,750 children in Palestine over the past year, and 90 children in Lebanon in the past two weeks. More than 50,000 Palestinian children under the age of four urgently need treatment for malnutrition, and many have already starved to death. We grieve for them, and for the Israeli and Yemeni and Syrian children who also fear for their lives. We grieve with the families of Palestinians and Israelis held captive, and we continue demanding our government end the massacres. This spring, President Biden said his red line was the invasion of Rafah in Gaza. The Israeli military invaded and destroyed Rafah along with the rest of Gaza, and then invaded the West Bank. But our government kept sending weapons and billions of dollars in military aid, in violation of international law and U.S. law. Israel’s government continues to escalate with the full backing of the United States, invading Lebanon and bombing Lebanon, Syria, and Yemen. The Biden administration has openly supported these attacks, even sending U.S. troops to the region. Our government can and must stop the bloodshed, rather than continuing to allow the Israeli government to operate with impunity as they carry out war crimes and threaten millions of lives in the region. As I’ve said since last October, the cries of Israeli and Palestinian children calling out for their parents sound no different to me... but so many U.S. government officials don’t see Palestinians as human beings worthy of life. We should be saving lives no matter people’s faith or ethnicity. We should be using our leverage to demand a ceasefire. How many more have to die before our country stops sending more U.S. bombs and funding this madness? Why is it that our country always has enough money to bomb people, but never enough to provide people with healthcare, housing, clean water, and enough food to feed their families? As we see U.S. weapons manufacturers’ stock prices soar, remember that members of Congress are permitted to own stock in war manufacturing. So when they vote to send more bombs or send our loved ones to war, they profit personally. That’s why I introduced the _Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act_ to ban members of Congress from investing in weapons contractors. As the only Palestinian American in Congress, I will keep speaking up and urging people in power to recognize our shared humanity. We all deserve to dream, to play, to grow old, to live with dignity. As the U.S. Jewish group IfNotNow writes: _“Our tears are abundant enough, and our hearts are big enough, to grieve for every life taken—every universe destroyed.”_ Right now our Jewish neighbors are in the holiest time of the Jewish year, during the High Holidays of Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. Our movement for a ceasefire includes people of all backgrounds, including countless Jewish Americans who are standing up and saying: Not in our names. We’ve heard from Israeli relatives of hostages taken last year on October 7 who have been condemning the Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu’s refusal to consider a ceasefire. Some came to the U.S. to protest Netanyahu’s speech in Congress, where many were arrested. Our movement for a ceasefire and equal human rights aims to protect everyone in the region, no matter their faith or ethnicity. We’re also trying to protect marginalized communities in the United States, including Arab Americans and Muslim Americans who are experiencing a frightening rise in violent hate crimes as elected officials and the media keep spreading racist, Islamophobic hate. Our communities are also facing rising antisemitism and xenophobia. My heart breaks for all of us. Together, our hearts keep breaking. Together, we will continue to work for real lasting peace that upholds human rights and dignity for all people and centers peaceful coexistence between Israelis and Palestinians. We will keep pushing back against dehumanization and reminding one another of our shared humanity. In love, sorrow, and solidarity, Rashida [DONATE NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtjzbjFBpR7JpBHI31l9kbTssL2iCd_LDl88OA1cO_uPZTh_4qb-dDV4KslVIGGFBvuyyaFVqhBAt39x-ueL4ETixkrokMRagJduoaIQcazkdCbSCvu5ojkJbTeHPEa_7kuqzI56F4fK4aEaL1vY1G782LzXDq1H9z0Zvh8v9Frs8zp52YmruklMKTgsnkM1qEicHVSY4Q_FyLhTCz-Fo3a7lcHwpUHly-vGMuqAMGxJE6IMOQeGbF4rJ6sWppkdgkbQAzZYq3AIHWiXCRueD-g8nepxfCNu1GYtrVRzi52s70K6JCeQmBYGPADRd3xgUUMk-h-uOfrrU6CfNgYM0TgcnzZZU7V6ar2GoJ-YeJBE0QT0GH_YmWXWcNt8MMDrmSFy0SSIyyEXI94VG8j9tyIbcMArryajIZY2wCIvJO5aKkWARPp7SyVISvhYYQjyIQ/4ae/ehizf8BNRUqD304wVvL-SA/h1/h001.uQbzrLAoa8cOKdWc_bavr_5TpWf1rKUn-GT-wPi7fXQ)

name: David Hogg
subject: Republicans need young voters
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Republicans know they have a problem with young voters.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241007&t=1&akid=1271%2E587540%2ECm9jaA)
Peter,
**Republicans know they have a problem with young voters.** It’s why they’ve spent so much time and effort trying to stop us from voting, whether it’s through restrictive voting laws designed to stop college students from casting ballots or their outrageous proposals to raise the voting age.
But they’re starting to wake up to the fact that whether they like it or not, young people _will_ vote if they’re motivated to turn out.
**So the GOP is changing tactics.** ALEC Action — the campaign arm of the American Legislative Exchange Council, which pushes for the passage of ultra-right-wing bills in state legislatures across the country — is teaming up with Run GenZ to boost young “conservatives” who are running for office.
**Seem like a familiar strategy?_We thought so too._** **[Will you pitch in $5 or any amount you can to help us double down on our strategy to elect _progressive_ young leaders instead?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241007?refcode=em20241007&amount=5&refcode2=1271_587540_Cm9jaA&akid=1271%2E587540%2ECm9jaA)**
But let’s be real for a second. The fact that the Republican Party is nearly entirely dominated by old, out-of-touch white dudes isn’t the real source of their problem with young voters (though it certainly doesn’t help).
**Republicans have a young voter problem because of their platform.** Young people today have grown up amidst near-constant mass shootings across the country, including in our schools. We see the evidence of a changing climate before our very eyes, and we know the impact it could have on our future.
But despite all this, Republicans have consistently fought to make it _easier_ to access **dangerous guns** and stood in the way of common-sense gun safety laws that could keep young people safe in school. And they continue to deny the reality of **climate change** in the face of overwhelming evidence.
Plus, while young people today are more pro-choice and pro-equality than ever, Republicans across the country have made it their mission to chip away at **LGBTQ rights** and pass draconian **abortion bans,** often with no exceptions whatsoever.
So MAGA is welcome to put a fresh young face on their horrible old policies — but that won’t change the fact that young voters are overwhelmingly opposed to their agenda.
**In contrast, Leaders We Deserve is working to elect young leaders who will fight _for_ young peoples’ priorities, not against them. But we’re a grassroots organization that takes no corporate funding, so we’re counting on your support to do it.**
[**If you want to expose the GOP's latest astroturfed effort to target young people as the sham it is, pitch in $5 or anything you can right now to help us elect the leaders we _really_ deserve on Election Day:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241007?refcode=em20241007&amount=5&refcode2=1271_587540_Cm9jaA&akid=1271%2E587540%2ECm9jaA)

Thanks for your support,
**David Hogg**

name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: Will pork or egg prices be higher in 2025?
body:
| Hi Peter, When it comes to grocery prices, some items have seen more dramatic changes than others. Take eggs and pork, for instance. Although prices have dropped in recent months, egg prices in June 2024 were 10.2% higher than those in June 2023.1 Meanwhile, pork prices increased by 3.81% from last year.2 These fluctuations show how unpredictable food prices can be. And when we look at more specialized items, like those used in sushi, the price changes can be even more striking.3,4
---

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94492210/503664614/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDY4OTc0YmUtY2Q4NC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ux0Oj1Lc9gerZVYSewH870yYu8jGNulioNucBePDbgk=&emci=fa06c7b7-cd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=468974be-cd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
In 2016, Donald Trump masterfully used news outlets like _The New York Times_ , _CNN_ , and _Fox News_ to dominate headlines and spread dangerous misinformation.
Trump's victory was, in part, the result of these legacy media outlets prioritizing ratings and profits over the truth—and our country hasn’t been the same since.
**Now, with less than a month remaining in what could be one of the closest elections in modern history, the media is once again giving Trump a platform to spread his lies in the guise of “balanced” journalism.**
We founded COURIER as a direct response to these failures. We believe that restoring public trust in journalism is essential to strengthening our democracy. Building that trust starts with calling out misinformation and delivering quality, local news to the communities that need it most.

At COURIER, we will never compromise the truth to make a quick buck. Here’s our commitment to you:
**1\. We will always call out right-wing misinformation and tell the truth.** There are no “alternative facts” or “both sides.” There is the truth, and we will hold right-wing bad actors accountable for their lies.
**2\. We will restore trust in journalism by covering local stories that matter most to the communities we serve.** The best antidote to bad information is good information. We will never compromise our values just to drive clicks and profit.
**3\. We will deliver our news to the online spaces where people spend their time.** Social media newsfeeds. Inboxes. Search engines. By bringing quality journalism to the online spaces where misinformation is thriving, our reporting dismantles right-wing propaganda in real time before it can spread.
**4\. With your support, we will continue our critical reporting after election day.** We know that Trump and the far-right media are already laying the foundation for another attempt to steal the election. By exposing their misinformation and publishing factual information in the swing state communities that will decide the election, we can stop another January 6th before it happens.
Right now, our newsrooms across 11 swing states are committed to reporting the facts on the issues that matter and calling out and combating misinformation wherever we see it. We don’t rely on a paywall or subscription model, so we can’t keep growing without your generous support.

clean_body: The Minnesota DFL Coordinated Campaign had a big week this past week, and we got much more this week! There are just 29 days to election day. It's time to leave everything on the field! Volunteers just like you are organizing their neighborhoods from Lutsen to Luverne. | | Bill Nye the Science Guy toured Minnesota stumping for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, and even did a science experiment at our Lake Monster Brewing event! The Minnesota DFL Coordinated Campaign had a big week this past week, and we got much more this week! There are just 29 days to election day. It's time to leave everything on the field! Volunteers just like you are organizing their neighborhoods from Lutsen to Luverne. Each week, volunteers like you , , and across Minnesota. With just 29 days until the last day to vote, | Minnesota hosted the largest Vice Presidential Debate Watch Party in the country with hundreds of supporters cheering on Tim Walz with Lt. Governor Peggy Flanagan. Key Minnesota DFL Coordinated Campaign events this week Monday - Sunday: | We hosted a Women of Color Brunch with Lt. Governor Peggy Flanagan, Illinois Congresswoman Lauren Underwood, Congresswoman Ilhan Omar, and many state and local elected women of color and allies. For the over 15,000 volunteers who have already signed up to , , or , thank you so incredibly much for organizing your community! If you haven't volunteered yet, we know it can feel like a big deal to even talk about politics these days, but you can make a big impact as a local Minnesota DFL volunteer. | Receive a lawn sign from the Minnesota DFL We know there is an incredible demand for lawn signs , and that's just one measure of the incredible enthusiasm DFL volunteers have for this ticket in this election. There are two ways you can receive a lawn sign from the Minnesota DFL before November 5: Volunteer in your community: When you at a DFL Action Center, you may receive a free lawn sign, no donation needed. Judge Joe's Briefing A NEWSLETTER FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL VOLUME 19 - October Dear Friend, I got into this race because I could not stand to see what was happening to our country and our state. I saw working families being left behind, soaring prices causing folks to struggle just to make ends meet, out-of-control crime, a wide open border, and drugs pouring into our communities. These are the issues I’ve built my campaign around because I want to solve the problems making Illinoisans’ daily lives harder. Economy The elites in this country have been hollowing out the industrial base of the United States for decades. As the jobs were shipped off to foreign countries, blue collar workers were left with nowhere to turn. Their once-thriving communities withered, their old factories rusted away, and their favorite small businesses shuttered their doors. Business-as-usual continued for the Wall Street executives, lobbyists, and D.C. politicians who enriched themselves all the while, without giving a damn about American families. If U.S. manufacturers insist on gutting our workforce by outsourcing American jobs, then those companies should have to pay a price. Tariffs are a double-edged sword and currently out of fashion with the elites at cocktail parties in D.C., but, the men and women who clock out before having a beer after work, they know tariffs are a necessary tool to protect their livelihoods. The deck has been stacked against blue collar workers for far too long and it is time to consider using every weapon in our arsenal to finally do something about it. Border Eric Sorensen has been putting the interests of illegal immigrants over the needs of everyday Illinoisans since the day he was sworn into office. He’s enabling violent criminals, cartels, and terrorists as they exploit our porous southern border. It’s extreme and dangerous. Now, every community in our state is a border community. Congress needs someone with an actual backbone to roll up his sleeves and secure our border once and for all. That is exactly what I am going to do because the people of Illinois are sick and tired of playing second fiddle to people who break our laws. When I’m in Congress, Illinoisans won’t take a backseat to anyone. Border I Judge Joe McGraw for Congress (youtube.com) Our Values Right now, our values are not being represented in Congress. There is no greater illustration of this than Eric Sorensen’s latest unhinged television ad in which he denigrates the tens of thousands of Illinoisans who believe in the power of prayer. Sorensen’s ad demonstrates how out-of-touch and elitist he truly is. We’ll never apologize for putting our faith and hope in God. If Eric Sorensen wants to attack us for praying too much, well, we will gladly wear that as a badge of honor. Get Out and Vote I believe our district’s best days are ahead of us. That is only going to happen, however, with the right leadership. With Eric Sorensen, the writing is on the wall – the only thing he cares about is protecting his own job. It’s time for a new direction. Early voting has started and I humbly ask that you get out and vote for me; and, once you do that, please encourage your friends and family to do the same. Scenes from the Trail Getting out the vote in Carroll County Joined a group of supporters for an event in Moline Hosting a meet and greet in Colona Working the polls in Freeport To stay up to date with the latest news from the campaign, please follow us on social media HERE and HERE. clean_body: | | | Peter, our campaign often gets the question: “Who is Kamala Harris?” It’s simple, really. In the face of injustice, she speaks out. In the face of bigotry, she stands up. In the face of Donald Trump, she walks across the stage, looks him in the eye, and shakes his hand. She is our next President of the United States. Pictures say a thousand words, so before we share some of our favorite parts of her story with you, Family is at the heart of who Kamala Harris is (if you couldn’t tell, she’s in the yellow jacket on the left). Her mother was tough and courageous, and she taught Kamala and her sister, Maya, to never complain about injustice -- but to do something about it. Kamala did exactly that. In 2004, she became the first Black woman to be elected District Attorney of San Francisco. Then in 2010, the first Black woman to be elected Attorney General of California. Every time she stepped in the courtroom, she stood proudly before a judge and said five words: Kamala Harris, for the people. Fast forward some years, and as senator, Kamala Harris held Trump’s Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh to account during his confirmation hearing. These are just a few of the highlights from Vice President Harris’s lifelong career of fighting for the people. Now, it’s OUR chance to make a new memory that gets on this photo board. The memory of electing Kamala Harris as our next President of the United States. ---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e331d2a795a34ac784ccb0ef46c13efd&_e=BRK4yUOqolaDDovsalE2CuU_FBznvg0CSwTj6wbWKS_PhFXG7hkl8wzBmTw2raA6MV3Pk-9jbXaJgE1RVZojwQwiZyHJUtQf2-1J2gfps8LGFsEvtxV89Szm9ibdS1QnVrY8-sbV2gYMpqmAQkEcVgdSj2BKZ5SFMp31S1hZnTHotGpohvHrn14ZsZB9lRHxHzyPZuj1mfjLWvtfwd477O3ZD7_VxHgpmKvHUCyFlMHK9j-n6rWR2pRlY_SMp4KDib-QGJN2oGPXBoaudEzslTDWhIJOg9YQgzXz6Cc1frgTAL4a9eTF45c1P3SlFDRg52dHapMImp-Vz-v9y2npi0CNF7Mcwiw27Bwtvru-bC5iYOuDJH2VFGpu4fEbE-9n)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e331d2a795a34ac784ccb0ef46c13efd&_e=BRK4yUOqolaDDovsalE2CuU_FBznvg0CSwTj6wbWKS_PhFXG7hkl8wzBmTw2raA6MV3Pk-9jbXaJgE1RVZojwQwiZyHJUtQf2-1J2gfps8LGFsEvtxV89Szm9ibdS1QnVrY8-sbV2gYMpqmAQkEcVgdSj2BKZ5SFMp31S1hZnTHotGpohvHrn14ZsZB9lRHxHzyPZuj1mfjLWvtfwd477O3ZD7_VxHgpmKvHUCyFlMF2iN94ea8TKPUJ5IsslQC8522j2GSmQlsyKk3dEOaDhC_bwUFKEVBPr93jg0DhzYppXHvIflcMHigrHvf81gewBMtc4uhd-Yi0pl3ZVQER5fHsSQZApPH_TMEaEo9bDeTSrpx4B68sogVmO03PvkXN)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

Dear Friend,
---
We've seen time and time again that the Lord has established the steps of Let Us Worship, and has conformed our plans to His will. Time after time, God led us INTO THE HEART of the heartbreak, where His presence is needed most. The images coming out wake of Hurricane Helene are heartbreaking. Entire communities have been wiped out and peoples lives have been up ended. In only God's timing, we are scheduled to hold revivals in Georgia and North Carolina just days after Hurricane Helene ravaged the area.
---
[**DONATE TO THE RELIEF EFFORTS >>>**](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=4e9013b26c24450aa009b5cd96d77326&_e=8kumCo4Ivt2R-tAQ0OfcNVcGyOUri99ukHCMRWycIew_VHehKGRPA9_85CYVm72_JSePvRtUaHt7vioZiBSAowb66IqtYqxqqyoUn2Uh6LQ9ktbW8m0YSDEWfTa8-3gJ4IdReI3ktgFPtA3DrRCVNQcQJmCONqhCaO-gRDPLcyrAonaFwOeUMYtj94rXOTbUntszIxUvQ8tp6bi8LNdvO2h-C4Gbh1_7l_qwxU-ZaUZxuKKT6z7CtF8CRMLszsgR)
---
Next week, we head to Georgia and North Carolina, and we are mobilizing our team and partnering with Operation Blessing to serve the citizens of Georgia and North Carolina. We are calling on EVERYONE planning to attend the revivals in Georgia and North Carolina to come with supplies. In talking to our contacts on the ground, here are the top items needed:➢ Diapers➢ Formula➢ Wipes➢ Cleaning supplies We rented a truck in Atlanta, and will be filling it with supplies and driving it up with us after the revival. Once there, we will help with the relief and distribution efforts, and will be holding a massive Sunday worship service. This effort has many moving parts, and we will keep you updated throughout next week, but one thing is clear—God meant for us to be in this area at this time, and we will bring the power of the Gospel and the love of Jesus with us!
---

Sean

We’ll say it again: This year’s election is the most critical election for climate action in our lifetimes. Every day, we see the devastating effects of the climate crisis — hurricanes battering our coastline, wildfires raging, heatwaves sweltering, and floods and landslides destroying entire communities. **And yet, Donald Trump and his fossil fuel allies continue to push their "Drill, baby, drill" agenda, accelerating the very disaster we’re fighting to stop.** JD Vance even repeated the slogan in the VP debate last week. We can’t afford to wait. We need to act now. **[That’s why we’re calling on YOU to step up and volunteer with the Jane Fonda Climate PAC during the final 29 days before Election Day. body:

---

# 2024 October e-newsletter
---
|
---
|
---
| **Board chambers now open to public at 500 County Center**
---
| Dear friends, The Board of Supervisors held its first meeting at 500 County Center September 24 when we approved a $5.25 billion budget for this fiscal year, the largest in San Mateo County’s history. I was excited to see the Board Chambers packed to capacity bright and early at 9 a.m. as the Board also voted to increase the amount set aside for General Fund reserves in the budget to 15 percent from 10 percent to ensure financial stability and maintain essential services particularly for underserved residents during economic downturns.
---
The budget reflects the values of the Board as we have prioritized constructing and rehabilitating affordable housing, ending homelessness, emergency preparedness, the needs of children, families and seniors with mental health being considered across all of these priority areas. The Board also proudly renamed Tunitas Creek Beach the Don Horsley County Park at Tunitas Creek Beach in honor of the former supervisor and sheriff who died earlier this year. The Board meets next 9 a.m., Tuesday, Oct. 8, Board Chambers, 500 County Center, Redwood City.
---
| **500 County Center hosts first major reception to celebrate the county’s past, present and future** Seven years ago, the vision of bringing a new county center came to life. I started this vision with the late Don Horsley in 2017 and continued through the years with current Board President Warren Slocum as we worked on a subcommittee together that prioritized climate change resiliency and the creation of a space that connected San Mateo County residents in a welcoming way to county government and services. I was incredibly proud to host a welcoming reception Sept. 19 at 500 County Center, the greenest civic building in the United States with guests including foreign dignitaries, former 49er greats, tech executives, my constituents and California State Controller Malia Cohen.
---

The keynote speaker was the building’s architect and abstract artist Javier Arizmendi, who spoke about the green aspects of the building, as it is the first civic building in the nation to be constructed with cross laminate timber. The reception also showcased an art exhibit featuring works by local artists including Arizmendi from the Andra Norris Gallery in Burlingame. The highlight of the night was perhaps when world-renowned singer Roxana Damas sang the National Anthem on the fifth-floor veranda overlooking the historic cupola that survived the 1906 earthquake and adorns the San Mateo County History Museum. Thanks for all who attended, it was a pleasure to see you all and to celebrate the county’s past, present and future.
---
|

**‘Loneliness to Light’ gathering highlights county’s commitment to connectivity**

Thank you to all who attended my office’s Loneliness to Light gathering in partnership with the Center for Age-Friendly Excellence (CAFÉ) Tuesday, Oct. 1 at the Regional Operations Center in Redwood City.

The event featured Dr. Anabel Pelham with CAFÉ, keynote speaker UCSF Dr. Carla Perissinotto, and Dr. Elissa Lee with California Volunteers in the Governor’s Office who all spoke on our collective efforts to raise awareness around the epidemic of loneliness. San Mateo County was the first in the nation to declare loneliness a public health crisis in January.

The event also showcased numerous projects and programs several cities have embraced to improve the lives of older adults under the Age-Friendly Cities Initiative my office has championed since 2018.

In Brisbane, the city has adopted several intergenerational programs to connect older adults and youth with karaoke nights, reading programs for preschoolers and the city’s Youth Advisory Committee offering tech support for older adults.

In Daly City, Mayor Juslyn Manalo spoke about its Intergenerational Music Therapy Program in partnership with Northeast Medical Services and a Hawaiian-themed “senior” prom that had 259 participants. The cities of Belmont, San Carlos and Redwood City also highlighted some of its programs at the event. To date 16 San Mateo County cities are now certified Age-Friendly by the World Health Organization which helps us all connect in new and meaningful ways.

To learn more, go to: [https://cfafe.org](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=cc1cfed714&e=c0babbc643)/

---
|

**GotWheels! expands to give older adults mobility options**

As Peninsula Family Service celebrates the fifth anniversary of GotWheels!, which started in Daly City in 2019, I’m proud to announce I have secured $900,000 this year alone from the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors and Metropolitan Transportation Commission to expand this low-cost transportation program for older adults across the county.

It’s a partnership with Serra Yellow Cab, shown in the picture above providing a ride for Daly City resident Norma Irving, which is the only wheelchair-accessible taxi service in the county.

Getting out of the house is an incredible way to connect with your community and break free from social isolation and loneliness.

Got Wheels! is available around-the-clock, for a cost of $5, to help older adults who may have mobility issues, and those who can’t drive due to not having a driver’s license, lack of driving skills or not owning a car.

The service, which can be used up to six times a month (six one-way trips or three roundtrips), is available to residents 70 years and above in Daly City, Colma, Brisbane, South San Francisco, San Bruno, San Francisco International Airport, Millbrae, Burlingame, Hillsborough, Half Moon Bay, Moss Beach, El Granada and Montara.

To learn more, go to: [https://peninsulafamilyservice.org/got-wheels/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=fd04d232ca&e=c0babbc643)
---
| **
Bay Wheels bikeshare to grow in Daly City**

The Metropolitan Transportation Commission in partnership with Lyft launched the first Bay Wheels bikeshare station in San Mateo County at the Daly City BART station earlier this year and I’m proud to say as an MTC Commissioner, I have helped secure another $1 million to expand the service in Daly City with up to 80 additional e-bikes and 8 to 12 new docking stations throughout the city.

These stations pave the way for safer bicycling and its successful debut at Daly City BART, the ninth busiest in the system, has prompted MTC in partnership with Daly City to provide more funding and support for Bay Wheels’ expansion.

It’s a last-mile commute solution that is better for the environment and better for the mind and body. Today, Amsterdam is considered to be the most bike-friendly in the entire world, but it was only a few decades ago that the city’s streets were clogged with cars like we are now. I’m proud to be a part of a growing movement that shows what a little pedal power can do.

The new docking station marks the first Bay Wheels location in San Mateo County and the continuation of a growth strategy that began last fall with the introduction of more than 1,500 new e-bikes and 30 new docking stations in San Francisco and San Jose.

Launched in 2017, Bay Wheels is the Bay Area’s regional bikeshare program with over 6,000 bicycles — both pedal-powered and pedal-assist electric bikes — at more than 500 stations in San Jose, San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, Emeryville and Daly City. Lyft operates Bay Wheels under a contract managed by MTC.
---

Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=141c82eaf7&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=20a522d254&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=8a314c8a51&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 In friendship,

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
President Trump in Wisconsin, a couple of Union endorsements, 1st District Fall Fest, and advocating for school choice in Milwaukee. | | | | |
---
| 29 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
**President Trump In Wisconsin** It was great to see President Trump back in Wisconsin on Sunday. We had a huge crowd on hand to hear from President Trump about the policies we need to get our country back on track.
I joined President Trump on stage to talk about the work I’m doing in Congress to ensure we have a safe and secure election this November.
Click the link below to learn more!
---
[Click Here to Hear More!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=2ca74ffe37&e=e907534017)
| **Union Endorsements** I was thankful to receive the endorsement of the North Central States Regional Council of Carpenters and the Operating Engineers Local 139 unions.
I’ll always back Wisconsin workers.
---
[Click Here to Read More!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=3adfb666da&e=e907534017)
| **First District Fall Fest** On Saturday afternoon the First District Republicans held a rally in Racine County to get-out-the-vote and talk about the policies we need to get our country back on track. We’re under 30 days until Election Day and we can’t take anything for granted.
---
| I’m grateful for all the hard work our grassroots volunteers have put in to get our message to every single voter in the First Congressional District. And I’m thankful for the work they’re going to continue doing until Election Day.
Want to join our grassroots volunteers? Click the link below!
---
[Click Here to Join Our Grassroots Team!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=7e0b864c34&e=e907534017)

Hey Friend, it’s Sianay, NextGen’s National Partnerships & Political Manager.
I pay pretty close attention to politics — _it’s literally my job_. I know how politicians think, and I generally know what to expect from them when Election Day looms large, **especially when it comes to young voters of color.**
A lot of politicians start making promises _**— many of them empty —**_ to court our votes. They understand that they need our support at the ballot box to get elected, but when it’s time to uplift our communities and deliver on the issues that got them elected, they ghost us.

Our voter registration campaign made a huge difference in 2022 and 2023. We've got no choice but to keep it going for 2024 -- all the way to Election Day -- and stop any chance of losing more of our voting rights to cynical conspiracy theorists spreading lies.

That means for every $15 we raise, five new voters can be added to the rolls ahead of the 2024 elections. With the last few years' voter suppression bills defining who gets to vote and how, we have to do everything we can to make sure we get as many pro-democracy voters filling out a ballot next year as possible.

Evacuation orders [have been issued](https://substack.com/redirect/feee6e75-be33-453f-86b4-c92e6f694336?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for millions of people across Florida's west-central coast as [Hurricane Milton](https://substack.com/redirect/5d41b57e-bf2b-4f1c-bd9a-58eee11e2096?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), now a Category 5 hurricane, crawls toward Tampa.
The Sun Coast area of Florida has _never_ had a direct hit from a major hurricane with a minimum central pressure below 930 mbar - at least not since record keeping began in 1851. The latest models show Milton's minimum pressure as 911 mbar.
Hurricane Ian (2022) was the strongest storm to ever hit the west-central Gulf Coast of Florida, but did so running mostly parallel along its coastline - not a direct, perpendicular hit, which causes the most extreme levels of storm surge and damage. So did Charley (2004). The 1921 Tampa Bay Hurricane hooked toward Tampa, but the storm's track and axis still wouldn't be considered a direct, perpendicular hit.

name: Gloria Witt
subject: Early End of Quarter Numbers
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Gloria Witt for Congress
body:
Our campaign has just made a powerful statement. We’ve released a strong finance report for this final quarter, | | | Let’s Seize the Opportunity
---
|
---
|
---
Hello Friends,Thanks to your incredible support, our campaign has just made a powerful statement. [**We’ve released a strong finance report for this final quarter**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67042bedcd88c7134b0fc857&u=https%3A%2F%2Fdocquery.fec.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Fforms%2FC00857219%2F1820772%2F&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67041a1fcd88c7134b0e46fb&l=en-US&s=cUGJ9nEUAEOjG31vpYo8NyiWmrk%3D), proving that our movement has serious momentum heading into Election Day. Together, we’ve shown what’s possible when a campaign is fueled by the passion and belief of everyday people.With your help, we’ve already secured a comprehensive Broadcast TV buy that will reach voters across the entire district! This is an accomplishment we should all be proud of! **Last quarter we raised over $218,627.38 from over 1,500 supporters giving an average of just $130 each.** That’s what a movement built by real people looks like.But we’re not done yet. This final stretch is about taking everything we’ve built and running through the finish line with strength and determination. [**We’ve pinpointed two areas in the district with the most Democratic voters who often stay home**](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67042bedcd88c7134b0fc857&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fwitt4congress%3Frefcode%3Dab_qr_code%26utm_source%3Dqr_code&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67041a1fcd88c7134b0e46fb&l=en-US&s=ccREBu553QV6xhvDOEAWH9pcfjc%3D), and our goal is to get on cable in those critical regions. We want to run an even stronger digital operation, ensure we have everything we need for Election Day, and make our final push to reach as many voters as possible.
---
The window is closing for us to make these crucial decisions. **What we do in the next few days will determine just how powerful our message** will be and how deeply we can connect with voters who need to hear our vision for a better future.I’ve always believed in being transparent and open, and that’s why I wanted to share these numbers with you early. **This is our campaign, built by and for the people, and I want us all to be on the same page.** [I’m deeply grateful for what we’ve accomplished together and I’m excited for what we can achieve in these final weeks.](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67042bedcd88c7134b0fc857&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fwitt4congress%3Frefcode%3Dab_qr_code%26utm_source%3Dqr_code&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67041a1fcd88c7134b0e46fb&l=en-US&s=ccREBu553QV6xhvDOEAWH9pcfjc%3D)With your continued support, we will defy the odds, flip this district, and build a future that works for everyone. Let’s show what’s possible when we come together for change.Filled with gratitude,Gloria Witt
Democratic Nominee
Virginia’s 5th Congressional DistrictP.S. Early voting started on September 20th, and Election Day is November 5th. Every single vote brings us closer to our goal. Let’s make it happen! **Keep in touch**
1. **Keep in touch: Like** the [Gloria Witt for Congress Facebook page](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67042bedcd88c7134b0fc857&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FGloriaWittforCongress&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67041a1fcd88c7134b0e46fb&l=en-US&s=usBNNG1oE1fh3cZiSqO7NUQBa0w%3D).
2. **Make a donation**
* [**Donate** ](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67042bedcd88c7134b0fc857&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fgloria-witt-for-congress-1&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67041a1fcd88c7134b0e46fb&l=en-US&s=Ik0GvkRVDxP4cpq8Kz8FEn0Plq4%3D)– Your contribution, no matter the amount, can make a difference in helping us reach our campaign goals. Small contributions make a difference!
* **Ask** a friend to [donate to the campaign](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67042bedcd88c7134b0fc857&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fgloria-witt-for-congress-1&w=65b51d9b10fa0e6aff8d6145&c=b_67041a1fcd88c7134b0e46fb&l=en-US&s=Ik0GvkRVDxP4cpq8Kz8FEn0Plq4%3D).

Folks, we’re coming down to the wire.
I’m proud to be fighting as hard as I can, supported by a team working around the clock to ensure Democratic victories on November 5th.
Let’s take a moment to remember why we’re doing this:
If Democrats win, we’ll expand the Child Tax Credit — which single-handedly lifted 8 million kids out of poverty, until the GOP let it expire and our child poverty rates doubled.
If Democrats win, we’ll keep lowering prescription drug costs so that our seniors and every American family can afford the medicine they need.
If Democrats win, we’ll protect women’s reproductive freedom so that every woman in America has the power to make her own choices about her body.
If Democrats win, we’ll take climate seriously and work towards a clean energy economy that protects our planet while creating more jobs.
And so much more — from passing the common-sense solutions to gun violence that the majority of Americans want to continuing to grow our economy with good-paying jobs to taking meaningful action on border security and immigration reform.
If Democrats lose... not only will we likely be unable to accomplish progress on these goals, but we could be facing dramatic setbacks that block the fundamental rights and freedoms of the American people.
The good news is that the future is up to us . We have the power to secure Democratic victories! But we need to take action. We need to vote, talk to our friends and neighbors about what’s at stake, make calls, knock on doors, and get the word out.
And if we can, we also need to ensure our Democratic candidates have the necessary resources to survive these final weeks.
My team has a detailed budget map of what needs to get done over the next 29 days — and implementing all of those plans depends on reaching our fundraising goals. So I’m asking: Will you pitch in $29 or whatever you can to help us get there? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thank you for everything you do. Whether you donate or not, I appreciate you reading these updates and staying involved in this hugely important election.
-Tim Kaine

I could talk endlessly about my opponent’s failed political career and our prior Senator's corrupt nature.

I could lean into the negative and the attacks.

_But that’s not who I am – that’s now how I’ve built my career._

**So today, I’d like to tell you why I am the right candidate for New Jersey,_regardless of what party you may believe in._ **

**My name is Curtis Bashaw. I'm a pro-choice, married gay Republican who believes the Government should stay out of our homes and that the gov shouldn't take all of our hard-earned money.

I’m socially liberal and fiscally conservative. I believe in freedom. I believe in the Constitution.

I believe we need politicians to STOP fighting with each other and START doing the job that they’ve been elected to do.

_I’m not your typical candidate, and that’s why I have a shot at winning._ **

I want to make things more affordable for folks, while letting them choose what they do with their bodies, who they love, and whatever else they want to believe. **But I also want to prioritize American citizens, securing the border is job #1. I want to make our cities safe, and put more of your hard-earned money into your pockets.**

_We can have it both ways._

So, I need your help. We have one month left to get this message out to every undecided voter in the state. Curtis Bashaw

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

I'm at my wits' end, Friend.

The Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising chest. Now, they've just dumped $5.5 million into Montana, and are set on defeating me.

At this point, if I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I lose my House seat, Republicans may never hold the majority in Congress again.
**Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump 's Secretary of the Interior and I was a ground forces commander at SEAL Team 6.**
**I 'm also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation.**
But if the Democrats can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance.
**In 2022, I led the team of Navy SEALs that retook the House Majority, and I have more conflict experience than anyone else. Point is, I 'm one of the toughest, well-tested Republicans in Washington D.C. If I can't beat the Democrats going after my seat - no one can.**

name: Jill Stein
subject: One Year of War and Genocide, Generations of Oppression
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
History didn't begin on October 7th, 2023.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=october_7th_1_year&n=1)
---
Peter, Today, October 7th 2024, marks one year since the Hamas attack on Israel that many consider to have sparked Israel’s US-backed genocidal campaign against Gaza that is now exploding into a regional war. But history did not begin on October 7th, 2023. To understand the current situation, we must look back at least as far as 1948 to the Nakba, the brutal mass expulsion of indigenous Palestinians from their homes by Zionist paramilitaries and the newly formed state of Israel. While the world has been watching in horror for the past year as this genocidal rampage has cut short hundreds of thousands of innocent lives, that one year was preceded by generations of violence, occupation, displacement, dispossession, apartheid, and ethnic cleansing. While we abhor violence, we must understand that settler colonialism, occupation, genocide, and all forms of oppression have always provoked resistance. If we merely condemned violence “on all sides” without first acknowledging the underlying conditions of oppression and doing everything we can to rectify those conditions, we would not only fail to address the root causes of the problem, but would risk becoming complicit in injustice by drawing a false equivalency between oppressor and oppressed. As Desmond Tutu observed, “if you are neutral in situations of injustice, you have chosen the side of the oppressor.” One of history’s greatest nonviolent changemakers, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., identified the “great stumbling block in the stride toward freedom” as “the white moderate who is more devoted to ‘order’ than to justice” and “who prefers a negative peace which is the absence of tension to a positive peace which is the presence of justice”. For too long, the US government has supported Israel’s version of “order” and “peace” that demands the systematic subjugation of Palestinians to violent injustice. But whenever people are denied their human rights, resistance is inevitable. Even President Kennedy recognized this with his statement that “those who make peaceful revolution impossible will make violent revolution inevitable.” Dr. King also recognized the hypocrisy and uselessness of condemning the violence of the oppressed without first addressing the violence of oppression: “I knew that I could never again raise my voice against the violence of the oppressed in the ghettos without having first spoken clearly to the greatest purveyor of violence in the world today - my own government.” The US government is fully complicit in the violence that Israel has inflicted on the Palestinians and others, after supplying Israel with over one hundred fifty billion dollars in military aid and shielding Israel from accountability to the international community for its long history of defying international law. For Americans to condemn Palestinian resistance while our own government actively oppresses the Palestinian people would be neither just nor conducive to peace. The events of October 7th, 2023 have been weaponized to justify the genocide of Palestinians. Yet it has become clear that official accounts of October 7th have not only been divorced from the historical context, but factually distorted to serve the agenda of the Zionist Israeli government. As one example, Australia’s [ABC News reported](https://jillsteinforpresident.nationbuilder.com/r?u=MFvn3yncv_o2I0vEv2sITpr-7K6ObpyMabHQnSipZ5hta3NzdULqeazCqdjves47Euhvp6QyAGx7xyezwLwIHCgb3HOsMgLtZwvitNzwuTnoSk3dhY1CbxPjZdOjqJ1XOCPpcf5M8LwG05wiNvIktg&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=october_7th_1_year&n=2) in September that Israeli forces apparently applied the “Hannibal Directive” on October 7th, killing an untold number of their own citizens in attempts to prevent them from being taken hostage. The official discourse on hostages has also been extremely one-sided, rarely if ever mentioning that thousands of Palestinians are held prisoner by Israel without charge. From the “Hannibal Directive” killings to Netanyahu’s disregard for the families of Israeli hostages to Israel’s expansion of the war far beyond Gaza, it’s clear that the Israeli government has not acted out of concern for hostages, but has only used those concerns as justification to launch a preconceived agenda of conquest and genocide. In just the last few weeks, the situation has gotten even worse. In a massive escalation of its genocidal war on Gaza, Israel has invaded Lebanon. Shortly thereafter, Iran launched a barrage of missiles at Tel Aviv in response to Israel’s attacks on Lebanon, Syria, Yemen, Palestine, and Iran itself, raising fears of an ever-expanding war in the Middle East that could even spark World War III, nuclear war, or both. If he wanted to, President Biden could stop this war with one phone call to the Israeli prime minister as Ronald Reagan did in 1982. Israel’s war machine is completely dependent on US taxpayer-supplied weapons, money, military and diplomatic support. But instead the Biden-Harris administration is complicit in Netanyahu’s plans to expand this horrific war. A recent Politico article titled “US officials quietly backed Israel’s push against Hezbollah” revealed that top Biden advisors actually encouraged Israel to invade Lebanon - despite the Democrats’ claims that Kamala Harris is “working tirelessly for a ceasefire”. We do not consent to be dragged into World War III by Netanyahu to support his genocidal land grab in Palestine, Lebanon, and beyond. By allowing Netanyahu to essentially dictate US foreign policy, Biden and Harris have abdicated the responsibility of their office. As President, the first thing I will do is make the phone call to stop this madness at once and fix the crisis at its source - by ceasing all support to Israel until it ends its genocide in Gaza and agrees to negotiate a settlement for Palestine and the region consistent with international law and the rulings of the International Court of Justice. The US, as the primary backer of Netanyahu’s military campaigns, holds the power to end his assault on Gaza and bring him to account. This is not a matter of diplomacy but of the US electorate exercising its responsibility by voting for leaders with the political will to act. As voters in the most powerful nation on Earth, we bear a unique obligation to hold our government and its allies accountable. By holding Israel accountable, the US can rejoin the international community, from which we have become increasingly isolated due to our government’s unconditional support for Israel’s defiance of international law. When the United Nations considered membership for Palestine this year, 143 nations voted in favor and only 9 against, including the US and Israel. But the US has consistently used its veto power to shield Israel from accountability, undermining any credibility our nation has to speak on issues of international law and human rights. As a Jew who grew up just after the Holocaust, with relatives who fled pogroms and a grandfather named Israel, I take “never again” seriously. And that means never again for anyone. In just the last year, I have met thousands of people from all walks of life, including Muslims, Jews, Christians, Palestinians, Israelis, Arabs, and many others from many ethnic, religious and spiritual backgrounds. And I can say with certainty from my personal experience that peace and friendship are possible. We can put an end to war, genocide, and generations of oppression, and start a new path to a world of peace, justice, and human rights for all.
---
In solidarity and gratitude, Jill Stein
---

body:
I wrote an op-ed in our local paper reaffirming my support of Israel and the Jewish community here in the Lower Hudson Valley.
Team,

Today marks one year since the horrors of October 7 committed by Hamas. I wrote an op-ed in our local paper reaffirming my support for Israel and the Jewish community here in the Lower Hudson Valley. Please take a moment to read it below, **[and then share it with your friends:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94501414/503695419/-1426732965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjE3ZDc4Ni1lMjg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yg6rf7_enVF6vxRjK2QlOtMZG5rjJ_ZvkAyTawkdLDo=&emci=633bfdc8-d784-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=5f17d786-e284-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=24719896)**

* * *
**[I will stand with Israel and Lower Hudson Valley Jews](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94501415/503695420/-1426732965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODAzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjE3ZDc4Ni1lMjg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yg6rf7_enVF6vxRjK2QlOtMZG5rjJ_ZvkAyTawkdLDo=&emci=633bfdc8-d784-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=5f17d786-e284-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=24719896)**

"As we mark the one-year anniversary of the horrors of Oct. 7, I write to reaffirm my long-standing support for Israel and our Jewish community here in the Lower Hudson Valley. As I said at the time, I condemn the atrocities committed by Hamas during the worst assault on Jews since the Holocaust, and I join people of good conscience in demanding that the terrorist organization release the hostages it cruelly took from Israel and other nations, including the United States.

I also condemn the equivocation in support for Israel’s right to self-defense that we have seen from some elected officials, including here in New York. That is why I stood with the Jewish community and endorsed Westchester County Executive George Latimer over Rep. Jamaal Bowman in the Democratic primary for the 16th Congressional District. I caught hell from people and organizations on the far left, but it was the right thing to do. Moreover, I condemn those protestors — whether on college campuses or in the streets — who would blame Israel and in some instances the Jewish people rather than Hamas for starting this war and the humanitarian crisis that has ensued.

I became a better legislator when I visited Israel in November 2021. It was the most educational trip of my life. For several days, I glimpsed and got to experience the palpable anxiety that people feel on a daily basis throughout the nation. I have been to the Iron Dome facility in Sderot, just miles from the Gaza border. I spent time at Zikim, a kibbutz that also sits along the Gaza border, and that exemplifies the principles of equality and communalism that the Jewish state of Israel was founded on. And of course I had the chance to visit, reflect, and pray at Yad Vashem in Jerusalem. Having spent time in Israel and the West Bank, it is clear to me that the only way to achieve a lasting peace between Israelis and Palestinians is for the hostages to be released and for Hamas to be defeated once and for all.

The past year, in which we have seen a surge in acts of antisemitism throughout America and the world, has been especially painful for our Jewish brothers and sisters. As I said in my remarks at Westchester Reform Temple in the days following Oct. 7, I am heartbroken by this hatred and bigotry and I am not Jewish. As someone who is Black and gay, I know what it is like to be discriminated against and to be targeted. No community deserves this.

As a Black American, I feel a special kinship with the Jewish community. I know that many of the freedoms I have today were secured through the efforts of Blacks and Jews working together as part of a civil rights coalition, whether it was the founding of the NAACP in 1909 or the thousands of young Jewish Americans who joined the struggle for racial justice in the 1960s, some even sacrificing their lives. For example, the courageous work of allies like Andrew Goodman and Michael Schwerner registering Black people to vote in Mississippi in 1964 — Freedom Summer — helped lead to the passage of the original Voting Rights Act.

I am reminded of Martin Luther King’s expression of solidarity to the American Jewish Congress in 1958:

“My people were brought to America in chains. Your people were driven here to escape the chains fashioned for them in Europe. Our unity is born of our common struggle for centuries, not only to rid ourselves of bondage, but to make oppression of any people by others an impossibility.”

In Congress, I was a champion for my Jewish constituents in combating antisemitism and supporting Israel. I did this through the legislative process and through using my platform as a U.S. representative. For example, I voted for every single appropriations bill containing U.S. aid to Israel, including for the critical Iron Dome and David’s Sling defense programs. I have been consistent in this regard throughout my time in public life.

Nevertheless, in the heat of an election here in the 17th Congressional District that will determine whether Democrats or Republicans control Congress next January, my opponent, Rep. Mike Lawler, and his allies are working mightily in the eleventh hour to distort that record. Lawler voted in the days leading up to Oct. 7 for an appropriations bill that would have cut security aid to Israel by nearly $1 billion. I would ask that no one allow themselves to be manipulated by the disinformation campaign of Trump and Lawler.

The future of American democracy has a big question mark next to it. Trump already tried to overturn the last presidential election, which I lived through as a freshman legislator at the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021. In his own words, he aims to ‘terminate’ the Constitution. My Republican opponent supports him for the third consecutive presidential election cycle. It is no surprise that the same people and organizations who would end democracy itself are now working to divide our civil rights coalition.

We cannot allow them to succeed.”

_Former Rep. Mondaire Jones is the Democratic candidate for the 17th Congressional District._

You've probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan, _"It's the Economy, Stupid."_ Clinton's political strategist, James Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team focussed and on the message.

The slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

**"It's the Senate, Stupid."**

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this year, but winning the White House – as critical as it is – won't be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate. Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his appointees or enact his second-term agenda.
**A Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a waste of a Republican president.**
**[**That's why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate candidates across the nation.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=805663bd151a468785ea72081ba6ab0e&_e=IKFBDdP0j53pn9P5xf_0NszlnQUIAReDUMbqv_gvtkv814OT0AA-gDS1dPbcaT5LPRtcncYgNkxie5tjIBmOrVHNG_Edj9Y5F0vzQ4PW7oOnOgNhdPMo5Gskf5bepc_6oGANf6wVo6h_gPtBw-Qo06tql7_HFAFWEl7ag_MNoPvxnbI3kEY_NYm7KXviwYiqW-qooaQrR1BcvDwyKh4ckORgaiJaPPfuXuj17xygUsvibL98pruIOdwF1_052LFqzzMUwiMAeG4piDWNEDQNgg%3D%3D)**
A president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation will never be signed into law.

_Does anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand American energy, and restore election integrity?_ Of course not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense policies will be passed. And if Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

****As we head into the final days of this election, we must support the conservatives running for U.S. Senate.**** These eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make America great and are willing to fight for them. They aren't liberal RINOs who will sell us out as soon as they're elected.

name: Alexandra Rojas
subject: One year ago
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Today marks a tragic anniversary for too many people. For Israelis, it
marks a year since Hamas attacked and killed over 1,000 Israelis and took
over 200 hostage. For Palestinians, it marks a year since the start of the
Israeli government’s genocidal campaign, which has now killed over 41,000
Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank.

Since last year, Justice Democrats and our elected leaders in Congress
have called for a ceasefire and de-escalation of violence to prevent an
all-out regional war. Above all, we want peace, safety, and freedom for
all people and this is not possible if we continue to send more weapons to
Israel and enable an all-out regional war.

The White House and Democratic leadership has failed us - succumbing to
Netanyahu’s racist hatred and AIPAC’s political pressure to support a
genocide despite the overwhelming majority of American people demanding a
ceasefire and an arms embargo with Israel. Voters watch their leaders
prioritize arming and funding Israel, while their livelihoods are put on
the backburner.

From the destruction that Helene has wrought in Appalachia to the
dockworkers who went on the first East Coast port strike in nearly 50
years, working families are under attack from unchecked corporate power,
all while their elected leaders are focused on dividing us and goading the
US into another endless war abroad.

True leadership is having the moral courage to enforce our existing laws
and say no to endless war. It’s standing up to Netanyahu's extremist
government and AIPAC's GOP billionaire-funded lobbying for genocide. The
Biden Administration and Congress must use all available leverage to
broker a permanent ceasefire, release of all hostages on both sides,
prevent a regional war with Iran and Lebanon, and finally, support a free
Palestine.

The will of the people is clear and soon those elected leaders who refuse
to represent their constituents’ interests risk being held accountable at
the ballot box.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

October 7, 2024 – Yesterday afternoon, Neil Parrott decisively won the League of Women Voters of Frederick County and Hood College Forum, showcasing his pragmatic approach to addressing the critical issues facing Maryland’s families. Neil delivered a clear message on how to combat inflation, create good-paying jobs, secure our border, and support law enforcement, all while emphasizing solutions over divisive rhetoric.

While Delaney’s campaign has relied solely on personal attacks, and now physical outbursts, Neil Parrott continues to focus on solutions to the issues that matter most to the people of the Maryland's 6th congressional district, offering a clear, constructive path forward.

Neil delivered a clear message on how to combat inflation, create good-paying jobs, secure our border, and support law enforcement, all while emphasizing solutions over divisive rhetoric. He is in position to flip this Democrat-held seat in November, bringing new leadership to Maryland’s 6th Congressional District. Peter, Today marks one year since Hamas’ horrific October 7 attack on Israeli men, women, and children. It was the most deadly massacre against Jews since the Holocaust. A year later, we continue to grieve the souls lost on that fateful day, and in the events following. We think of those who are still held hostage, we pray for their safe return and reunification with their families. This anniversary is particularly poignant, as it is amid the Jewish High Holy Days — where repentance, renewal, and hope prevail. But, antisemitic hate crimes have surged rapidly since October 7. Now more than ever, we must stand with our Jewish brothers and sisters. We must support our neighbors and Jewish communities that comprise the very district, state, and nation we call home. subject: It’s Time to Prioritize Americans in Need

body:
Why is federal aid going overseas during a natural disaster? | | | | | [](https://loydforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7327bfa58b5cc163333c9ac3&id=0beb7c68c6&e=5d2638fc3c)
---
| | | | | Friend,
Like you, I’ve watched in shock as the federal government struggled to deliver food, water, and shelter that Americans so desperately needed in the wake of Hurricane Helene. **Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas himself admitted that FEMA is already running out of funds this hurricane season.**
Yet, Kamala Harris put out a recent statement that **the United States is now providing over $127 million to Lebanon for ‘humanitarian’ reasons.** It is shameful to see that our own citizens are getting left behind while other countries continue to receive hundreds of millions in US taxpayer funds. Where is the help for our own people?
---
[](https://loydforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7327bfa58b5cc163333c9ac3&id=e37ce48218&e=5d2638fc3c)
| Now we have Category 5 Hurricane Milton on its way, ready to impact millions of U.S. citizens. **We cannot have our federal government continue to spend recklessly overseas while our people suffer and lose their lives to natural disasters.**
As your next Congressman, it is my priority to ensure that American tax dollars are used where they’re needed most—right here at home.
I need your continued support to win this race and stand up to Congress to ensure our federal spending goes to Americans in need first before any political deals on the other side of the world.
[**Will you chip in today? Please consider making a generous donation of any amount to my campaign to show you support the government prioritizing American citizens in desperate need first and foremost.**](https://loydforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7327bfa58b5cc163333c9ac3&id=f8c3a7c49e&e=5d2638fc3c)
---
[DONATE TODAY](https://loydforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7327bfa58b5cc163333c9ac3&id=b29df6b77d&e=5d2638fc3c)
| American citizens have already lost their lives, and we’re in for another major disaster. **We must have leadership that is willing to act quickly** and provide the resources our own people need to survive.
As always, I thank you for your continued support.
---
| Regards, Joshua Loyd[R] Candidate for Congress - IL-13

| | Dear Friend,Populism is a word often used to describe emerging political trends around the world. But populism isn't just a modern phenomenon -- it goes back centuries.
---
| [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-mTw3CycX1ukJMbz8smA)
---
| | Traditionally described as a battle between Left and Right, political differences are actually far more complex. What we are witnessing today are two distinct populist movements challenging party establishments across the West. Remarkably, these tensions can be traced all the way back to Roman times.

This is why I'm reaching out to you today. I want to offer you a free copy of one of our most insightful eBooks: **Dueling Populisms** by Victor Davis Hanson. Hanson, a Hoover Senior Fellow and acclaimed historian, provides a unique perspective that I believe you'll find incredibly valuable.

In **Dueling Populisms** you'll discover:
* What to expect from a political landscape dominated by movements that oppose both the establishment and each other.
* The striking similarities between ancient populist movements and today's progressive and conservative populisms.
* Insights into what the future holds for America as we navigate these revived ancient tensions in our modern culture.

This eBook is especially relevant as we face increasing political polarization and try to anticipate and understand election outcomes. By understanding the historical context of these populist movements, you'll gain a clearer view of our current environment and the potential paths forward. Hanson's expertise will help you see beyond the surface of today's political debates and grasp the deeper currents at play.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to deepen your understanding of today's political dynamics. Get your free copy of **Dueling Populisms** using this secure link: [Get Your Free eBook](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

I hope that it helps equip you to understand and participate in the civic discourse in the coming months.

The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

Friend, you might think I'm nuts when I say I'm going to tell you a story about voting rights and McDonald's – but **today is the last day to register to vote in Ohio** , so stick with me here.
I believe that voting is one of our most fundamental rights as Americans and that democracy only works when we're all able to make our voices heard. So back in the day as Ohio's secretary of state, I set out to register _as many eligible voters as possible_.

**A huge part of running any successful campaign is meeting people where they are – so that's exactly what I did: I reached out to McDonald's and got them to print voter registration forms on their tray liners, like the one here.**

name: Natalie Jones
subject: Today is Child Health Day!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Freedom Virginia, Inc
body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
This Child Health Day, we recognize that living with children means expecting the unexpected. Every day comes with joy, stress, love, and surprises, but parents and caregivers expertly roll with the adventures that each new day brings. What happens when the unexpected is an illness or injury?
55% of working Virginians can’t afford to take unpaid leave, forcing them to make the impossible choice between working and caring for themselves or their families. Children’s health and well-being go beyond healthcare; children and families need accessible childcare so caregivers can continue working to provide food, shelter, clothes, and anything else a child needs to grow up and be healthy.
In the past year, a freeze on funding for subsidized child care has left many Virginians with no options.
https://www.vpm.org/news/2024-09-30/subsidized-child-care-state-funding-southwest-virginia-carrie-coyner [https://www.vpm.org/news/2024-09-30/subsidized-child-care-state-funding-southwest-virginia-carrie-coyner]
Read the Full Article Here [https://www.vpm.org/news/2024-09-30/subsidized-child-care-state-funding-southwest-virginia-carrie-coyner]
Many Virginia families have found childcare but can only start sending their children once their subsidy vouchers come through. Some localities want to open more slots for low-income families to access childcare but can’t until more people have signed up. The problem is that people can’t sign up until they receive funding or vouchers, creating a frustrating loop for families. No one should have to choose between providing for their family and taking care of their family, yet many Virginia families are facing this decision right now.
When situations like this arise, it becomes clear we need to expand access to childcare in Virginia.
Natalie Jones
Communications Manager

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94506578/503714025/2113074009?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.10.07_JohnGoodman_B1_F1_S1_C1_30OP_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY2ZDQ5Yy1mMTg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=llchxztJDQOSzLUM8c25MWz_JqbTuJC7HGgHrhnQFas=) Hey there, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here. **The stakes are high this election year — especially in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race.** Here we’ve got Josh Hawley, the coward of January 6th, up against Lucas Kunce, a 13-year Marine veteran who knows what it’s like to grow up through hardship, fight for his community, and serve our country. I’m proud to support Lucas, and in a moment I’ll ask you to join me in splitting a donation between him and Lisa Blunt Rochester. But first, I want to tell you why I know that Lucas can defeat Hawley this year and why his grassroots campaign urgently needs our help. **Please let me explain.** | | [**CHIP IN NOW »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94506579/503714026/2113074009?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.10.07_JohnGoodman_B1_F1_S1_C1_30OP_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY2ZDQ5Yy1mMTg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=llchxztJDQOSzLUM8c25MWz_JqbTuJC7HGgHrhnQFas=)
