I’ll be honest: I’ve been ready to defeat Josh Hawley since January 6th, 2021.
He totally disgraced my home state that day...raising his fist because he wanted to look strong, and then running away like a little coward out the back door.
**But Josh Hawley has done a lot more than just that to embarrass Missouri over the years, stuff you probably wouldn’t even believe.**
Hawley himself played a major role in overturning _Roe v. Wade_ — he even bragged about it! He backs the total abortion ban in Missouri, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, and is a pioneer of the legal movement threatening access to IVF and birth control nationwide.
Hawley forced Missouri taxpayers to cover his legal bills after he broke the law — $250,000, in this economy! He’s refused to invest a single dollar in Missouri, instead spending all his time writing stuff like his “Manhood” self-help book.
It’s just shameful.
| [**CHIP IN NOW »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94506580/503714027/2113074009?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.10.07_JohnGoodman_B1_F1_S1_C1_30OP_N-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMTY2ZDQ5Yy1mMTg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=llchxztJDQOSzLUM8c25MWz_JqbTuJC7HGgHrhnQFas=)
---
**Now let’s talk about Lucas Kunce.** I learned about Lucas probably the same way many of you did: from online ads and emails just like this one.
I heard Lucas’ story of struggle and community, which reminded me of my own. I’m sure it resonates with you too. I also saw he was running a real campaign — outraising Hawley, earning record-breaking support, bringing people together regardless of what party they’re from or who they’ve voted for before.

You've probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan, _"It's the Economy, Stupid."_ Clinton's political strategist, James Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team focussed and on the message.

The slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

**"It's the Senate, Stupid."**

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this year, but winning the White House – as critical as it is – won't be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate. Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his appointees or enact his second-term agenda.
**A Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a waste of a Republican president.**
**[**That's why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate candidates across the nation.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=0646383616254a6da68a3fc40e860272&_e=bqlGAavoQjRVoVs21y4mh8is577mZgB2YmcsW4czjaa6GjwwfYIa42qcDDVkshZIIXkiv2-Nbd-Yea6EM1SQlaJST7cncLr2D5fD3GKuyPdMEFE-z61tpOD446R1babwhlOMqLndw1Kg8bSX2eGh59cwkDitXHTf_moLG0DlPGrdwbKMoI0JYnyMBSiaq1oehWetO01mVKjB4R4SRP2_cvgecevOh19ef-lXG_KXVjzojUzf_U_rpsjHUXcxjkE1ygj8CNDJGpVZBh4OQ-4kyA%3D%3D)**
A president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation will never be signed into law.

_Does anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand American energy, and restore election integrity?_ Of course not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense policies will be passed. And if Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

****As we head into the final days of this election, we must support the conservatives running for U.S. Senate.**** These eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make America great and are willing to fight for them. They aren't liberal RINOs who will sell us out as soon as they're elected.

_**You’re not going to believe this – but New Mexico is officially in play!**_ That’s right – a state so deep in the pocket of the radical left that they had it locked down for years is now on the verge of flipping **RED**.

Radical leftist Senator Martin Heinrich is an entrenched career politician and puppet for the Harris-Biden regime. They have failed so catastrophically that even a blue state like New Mexico is turning on them.

**Nella Domenici** is leading the charge for New Mexico Republicans to take back their state – and we need your help to get her elected. Nella is a fighter and will restore fresh, common-sense leadership back to Washington D.C.

#
I think Kamala Harris being the Democratic nominee for President is a rediscovery of what hope feels like, in a much deeper way.
It’s the difference between bailing out a boat, and sailing a boat. When you’re so consumed with, “How do we keep this thing up?” — it’s stressful, and important.
But now — we can look up and say, **“Where do we want to take this thing?”**
And to me, the long term of where we want to take this is people’s joy, dreams, and the fight for guaranteed healthcare, for a living wage, and for union jobs.
There are just 29 days left until we have a rare and precious opportunity to elect a President who is _for_ the middle class — because she is _from_ the middle class.

name: John Avlon
subject: We need to talk about Omer Neutra.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=1007 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=1007]
Friends,
It has been one year since this son of Long Island was taken hostage by Hamas terrorists in the horrific attack one year ago, on October 7th.
The world has witnessed the ever-widening cycle of violence ever since, and we mourn the death of every innocent civilian. But we cannot forget how this conflagration began and we cannot lose the sense of moral clarity that comes with confronting the tyranny of terrorism.
New Yorkers understand from hard experience that we must always stand with the victims of terrorism and not blame the victims of terrorism. As a former journalist and author of a book on extremism, I believe that there is a special responsibility among people who are not Jewish to stand up to antisemitism and stand up for the state of Israel’s right to exist.
Nonetheless, over the past year, there has been an impulse to overlook the hostages in our culture instead of the sustained attention each and every one deserves. But this one hits closer to home.
Omer was born in the wake of 9/11. His mother Orna evacuated Manhattan by foot over the Queensborough bridge months before he was born. Like every child who arrived while Ground Zero was still smoldering, he was a symbol of enduring hope in a civil society where posters of missing persons dotted the cityscape for months.
He grew up in Plainview and excelled at school and sports. He was a happy child and a natural leader. His love of the Knicks in the 2010s helped strengthen his innate optimism and resilience.
After graduating from high school, he took a gap year in Israel, planning to attend Binghamton University. He decided to join the IDF as part of his commitment to public service. He responded to the massive terror attack that began with an assault on young people dancing at an open-air concert. It was an assault that targeted women with sexual violence and left dead children on the dusty ground. We cannot ignore or whitewash those atrocities that left more than 1,200 dead and over 250 individuals held hostage. Omer was among them.
We have seen miraculous rescue missions succeed in liberating hostages being held in Gaza. We have received the heartbreaking news that many more bodies have been recovered. Omer’s whereabouts are still unknown. His parents Ronan and Orna have been tireless in their advocacy for the son, speaking to Democrats and Republicans and President Biden. Their steadfast courage and love in the face of this nightmare should inspire and guide us all.
Soon after I began this campaign in the winter of 2024, I was asked at a debate whether I supported an immediate ceasefire. I immediately and instinctively said, “not unless all the hostages are released.” I still believe that is a necessary precondition for peace.
Throughout this tumultuous year, I have seen the fading away of the rightful focus on the hostages. I have marched with those local citizens who fight to keep their memory alive, walking with police escort because of the threat of further violence. We need to stop the hate here at home – condemning hate crimes against synagogues, temples, and mosques alike.
We need to work toward a just and lasting peace in the Middle East. We need a two-state solution with a demilitarized Palestinian state, the eradication of Hamas, and an extension of the Abraham Accords that recognizes Israel’s right to exists and rebuilds Gaza into something better than it was under Hamas. These are not easy goals and they will not be achieved from the extremes.
But it is our responsibility to see that Omer Neutra does not fade from memory. He is a son of New York, a child of Long Island. And he is not forgotten. Just the other day, at the Sweet Hollow Diner, in Melville, a woman came up to me and pleaded to keep the focus on the release or Omer, pointing down the street and saying with despair, “he grew up just a few blocks from here!”
We will keep our promise as a community. We will march and walk and talk together to commemorate this dark anniversary and we will not rest. Because there can be no just and lasting peace until all the hostages are released.
-John

Hey folks — I know you have better things to do than read these emails, but I hope you’ll give me just a minute of your time.
I’m in the race of my life, and the odds against our campaign keep stacking up.
I’m running against an ultra-wealthy, handpicked opponent who can write his campaign million-dollar checks at the drop of a hat.
Experts have ranked Montana’s Senate race a toss-up, and with recent polls locked in a tie, it’s anyone’s to win.
And a super PAC just made a NEW seven-figure ad buy in Montana to help my out-of-stater opponent win.

name: Veronica Slajer
subject: Join the Fight for Fair Elections: Mary Peltola vs. Trump’s Radical Agenda—The Choice is Clear
body:
Democracy is under threat across our nation, and Alaska is no exception.| | |
---
| | Dear Friend, Democracy is under threat across our nation, and Alaska is no exception. We need leaders who are committed to protecting democratic values and ensuring that every vote counts. **Mary Peltola has been a steadfast advocate for fair elections and democratic principles.** She supports policies that make it easier for Americans to vote and has worked tirelessly to ensure our election systems are secure and transparent. Donald Trump has a very different vision—one focused not on fairness but revenge and retribution; not on the American people and himself. According to new [research](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94508161/503719761/-1839302773?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNDQzMTQwOS1mODg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZfOWFlhDJbqjwO8XCrc-FgZFw2QXmbbaeqiaUyDIHQ0=&emci=98b7f89e-f684-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=c4431409-f884-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=9512399), Donald Trump’s campaign proposals would add more than twice to the national debt as Kamala Harris’s would. Given the chance, Trump and his MAGA allies will keep stacking our courts and eroding democracy with lies and threats, locking in their extreme agenda for decades. **We cannot let that happen.** The extremist far-right plan to remake America in their image is bad for our country and bad for Alaska. Please join Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund (BAF Action) in supporting Mary Peltola to fight a radical agenda which should have no place in America. This is an all-hands-on-deck concern. **We need to do our part to protect the country from far-right extremism, and that means re-electing Mary Peltola. ** Please join us in supporting Mary Peltola to fight a radical agenda which should have no place in America. Thank you for acting now during this critical time,
Veronica Slajer

body:
How I’m feeling.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94508252/503720109/-1463099547?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTg2ZTQzMmYtZjg4NC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XARkf3Zqp7GQSF66t9FSuFrGVwneyZ6Llk8mZgWOWQU=) | Peter, Voters in California are receiving their ballots this week, and I’m feeling a mix of emotions. I’m extremely proud of the work we’ve done together, but I have to level with you... I’m also really nervous at the same time. Republicans are flooding our district with attack ads, so much so that every time I turn on the TV, I see their ads. And if I’m seeing them, then voters certainly are too. We have our response ad up and running, but this race is going to come down to a simple question: **can we convince every single Democrat to mail back their ballot?** As you know, we have a massive organizing program and our volunteers are doing an incredible job reminding Democrats what’s at stake in this election. But, we only have a few weeks to get our supporters to mail back their ballots. We have to make sure volunteers have what they need to be successful. That means we still need to print more lit, purchase water bottles, and repair our vandalized signs. We can’t let up now. **[Can you chip in today to help us keep going strong? If there was ever a time I needed you the most, it’s now. We’ve got so much more to do.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94508253/503720110/-1960673069?&refcode=E10911-20241007-VotingStartsToday-SL-2024Race&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTg2ZTQzMmYtZjg4NC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XARkf3Zqp7GQSF66t9FSuFrGVwneyZ6Llk8mZgWOWQU=)** \- Josh

29 DAYS!
To Get Me in Washington–
Vote for Trump
Dear Peter,
29 days.
The stakes are sky-high.
This may be the most critical election of our lifetime.
[And I want to remind all my supporters that the only way to bring about the change we so desperately need is to _vote for Donald Trump_.](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_7_24_all_1&n=5)
**Voting for Trump** isn’t just a vote for him; it’s a vote to restore free speech, end government overreach, and fight back against the forces trying to silence us.
So, wherever you live – red state, blue state, or swing state – it’s essential to vote Tump.
Let me make this real for you. Right now, free speech is under withering and relentless attack in America and across the globe. In a lot of countries, the state controls the media and censors the internet. Brazil just banned Twitter because Elon Musk refused to censor user speech.
Kamala Harris says Musk better behave himself or he will “lose his privileges.”
She thinks – and the Democratic establishment thinks – free speech is a privilege.
**__Well, I think it is a right_._**
And if Kamala Harris is elected, the powers behind her will quash that right. They are already halfway there. It will be too late by 2028.
**Once we are in the grips of totalitarianism, we won’t be able to vote our way out of it. This is our last chance to stop them.**
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_7_24_all_1&n=6)
After long conversations with President Trump and his team, I know that he is fully convinced of this priority. He sees the censorship machine for what it is. Remember, he was kicked off Twitter back in 2021.
And he has experienced directly how government agencies are being weaponized to destroy political opponents.
[**He is going to be relying on me to help clean up that corruption, and that’s why I’m relying on my supporters to help him return to the White House.**](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_7_24_all_1&n=7)

President Trump needs to win in a landslide both in the Electoral College and the popular vote. He can’t do it unless my supporters join him and look at the big picture.
**We have to unify** if we are to overthrow the entrenched elites who are ruining our country.
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote_trump_10_7_24_all_1&n=8)

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Ohio is ready to vote!
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
This is it — the moment we’ve been working toward for months.
Today is the LAST day for Ohioans to register to vote before early voting begins TOMORROW.
Two quick things before I go any further:
MAKE SURE you are registered to vote.
If you’re in Ohio, you can register online up until MIDNIGHT tonight. But don’t wait, click here and register now [https://olvr.ohiosos.gov/] . (If you’re not in Ohio, you can check your status here [https://www.vote.org/am-i-registered-to-vote/] .)
Forward this email to 4 friends to check their voter registration, too.
No matter which state you live in, Republicans are pulling all kinds of dirty tricks to throw people off the voter rolls. Don’t get caught unprepared at the ballot box!
With early voting kicking off tomorrow, that means voters are making their decisions about who to vote for as we speak – and this is our chance to take an early lead!
I have to tell you, Jim Jordan is feeling the heat! He’s been bombarded by our media blitz and he knows we’re statistically tied in the polls. More and more voters understand who Jim Jordan is and why he’s unfit to continue representing us.
Now we need to KEEP the pressure on. With the stakes higher than ever, we need every resource to kick our campaign into hyperdrive.
Now that early voting is about to kick off, we need everyone to step up for this final push. Will you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 to fund our efforts? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241007_early_voting_link1]
Instead of serving Ohio, Jim Jordan has spent his 17 years in Congress making his mark as a chaos agent.
He’s enabled seditionists, aided January 6th traitors, and protected those who sought to overthrow our democracy.
Jordan is the guy who prioritized sham judiciary hearings over the needs of Americans – even his own party once called him a “legislative terrorist.”
Tell your friends, family, and neighbors that if they want to see an end to extremist dysfunction and ULTRA-MAGA chaos, they need to donate to our campaign immediately and help us FIRE Jim Jordan.
FIRE JIM JORDAN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241007_early_voting_button1]
We have a choice: continue down a path of dysfunction or elect leaders who will fight for women’s rights and reproductive freedoms, lower the cost of living, and show up for our veterans who have given so much to this country.
This is the most important congressional race in the country, because we have the opportunity to replace a seditious traitor with someone who truly cares about our country.
Together, we can kick Jim Jordan out of Congress and restore sanity, service, and leadership to our district and country.
Every dollar puts us closer to ending Jim Jordan’s political career. This is our moment – let’s seize it. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241007_early_voting_link2]
One last thing before we go: With only 29 days to go , we need all hands on deck.
If you’ve got a few minutes a day you can help us FIRE Jim Jordan by signing up to volunteer from anywhere in the country!
Click here to get started [https://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer/] and someone on my team will reach out right away!
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/Screenshot%202023-08-30%20at%2012.16.45%20PM.jpeg]
Donate to Tamie Today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241007_early_voting_button2]
Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

subject: Help us fight corporate greed!
body:
| | | | | [](https://katrinaforarizona.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b33bbe17b20417c692e3cf693&id=d9dcd86a8a&e=a7c9c08fba)

| Hey, It’s Katrina Schaffner, here. Ballots are delivered this week and we need your help!
Career politicians, like Andy Biggs, have put up blind spots and are completely out of touch with everyday life. Over HALF of all Members of Congress are millionaires.
I have worked in the trades, in corporate and have been a political activist my entire adult life. I understand how federal policy impacts our day to day lives and how government should impact our daily life. We need more working class representation in Congress. The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

This is what Moreno is up against – lies, lies, and more lies – yet he only trails Brown by 3 points. **MISSOURI** – Senator **Josh Hawley** (R) faces Marine veteran **Lucas Kunce** (D) who is pretending to be a centrist. I’m not sitting this election out.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94509047/503722747/1328794144?refcode=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4YjExNjI5LWZkODQtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wpuxAyeY35rbX0EHap0kDyfnh92S_hjL6hsaB-H2b7s=&emci=34509bb7-ed84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)
---
| **“Why actor Jane Fonda is going door-to-door to support local candidates in 2024”** _\- CBS News, 10/05/2024_
---
Over the weekend, _CBS News_ aired a special interview with me about the critical work we’re doing here at JanePAC and why I’m dedicating every ounce of my energy to this election cycle.
If you didn’t catch it, I want to share a bit about how the interview went — but first, I have a personal request: **[Would you be willing to chip in a few dollars today to my organization, the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, so we can maximize support for our endorsed climate candidates before November 5th? Thank you so much.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94509049/503722749/2105508926?refcode=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4YjExNjI5LWZkODQtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wpuxAyeY35rbX0EHap0kDyfnh92S_hjL6hsaB-H2b7s=)** Now, about my interview with _CBS..._
I’ve spent my life fighting for justice, from protesting wars to marching for women’s rights. But as I told David Schechter, I am spending the rest of my life dedicated to the most important fight I’ve ever faced: the climate crisis.
This election is our last, best chance to make a real difference in the climate fight. With just 29 days left, we need to mobilize like never before to secure wins for climate leaders across the country. I’ve committed myself entirely to this mission — **I even told my agent that I won’t be taking any acting jobs this year.** That’s how important this is to me.
My team at JanePAC has hand-picked over **_130 candidates_** who are ready to fight back against the fossil fuel industry. We’ve even raised **_$4 million_** to support them, but the work doesn’t stop there. It’s about building power from the ground up, so these climate champions can rise through the ranks and transform our country’s policies.
[**DONATE NOW**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94509051/503722751/2105508926?refcode=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4YjExNjI5LWZkODQtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wpuxAyeY35rbX0EHap0kDyfnh92S_hjL6hsaB-H2b7s=)
---
About 70% of Americans are really concerned about the climate crisis, and when asked why they don’t take action, so many of them say, “Well, nobody asked.” I’m asking now. We need to take bold action together.
This is why you might see me knocking on doors across America. It’s not glamorous work, but it’s fulfilling. In fact, I’ve been on the ground canvassing for Vice President Kamala Harris and many of our endorsed candidates in Michigan and California.
Connecting with climate voters fills me with hope. And I’m channeling that hope into action every single day.
If we have the right people in office, we can push back against the fossil fuel industry’s greed and build a future that’s sustainable and just. But I need your help. With 29 days left, every dollar counts, and every action matters.
**[If you feel as inspired as I do — or if you’re sick and tired of waiting for our leaders to take real action on climate — then I encourage you to chip in today and join us as we approach a historic election for climate action in 29 days. It’d mean the world.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94509053/503722753/2105508926?refcode=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.b8b11629-fd84-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4YjExNjI5LWZkODQtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wpuxAyeY35rbX0EHap0kDyfnh92S_hjL6hsaB-H2b7s=)**

I want to outline our campaign's message to fill Maryland’s open U.S.
Senate seat. It hinges on 3 major components:

Power to the People

This campaign has never been about me,
Peter. It’s always been about
Marylanders, our families, and our communities.

And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic
Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country.

That’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race. But
during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by the many,
not by the money.

We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark
money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots
coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to
volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign.

Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary
victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win on
Election Day.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his
divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to
people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving
our democracy.

My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that
as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to
abortion care throughout the state.

Wow.
Tim Kaine debated his opponent Hung Cao last week. Here’s what you need to know:
Hung Cao still doesn’t think women all across the country should be able to make their own reproductive choices without government interference.
Tim Kaine is a lead sponsor of the Reproductive Freedom for All Act and doesn’t believe the government should get involved in women’s private medical decisions. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hung Cao has no defense for his plan to raise taxes on more than a third of Virginians.
Tim Kaine has taken action in the Senate to lower costs for families across Virginia and America. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hung Cao doesn’t want any restrictions on guns in this country.
Tim Kaine believes we need common-sense safety measures to make sure people who are a danger to themselves or others can’t buy dangerous weapons. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hung Cao supports a plan to put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block, hanging our seniors out to dry.
Tim Kaine helped secure a $35/month cap on insulin costs for seniors and lowered prescription drug prices. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hung Cao opposes a bipartisan border security bill that would have secured the border and cracked down on fentanyl trafficking.
Tim Kaine supported the bill, and introduced and passed the bipartisan Disrupt Fentanyl Trafficking Act to direct increased federal attention to fentanyl trafficking. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hung Cao wants to repeal the Affordable Care Act, putting 700,000 Virginians at risk of losing their health coverage and gutting protections for the 1.3 million Virginians with pre-existing conditions.
Tim Kaine has voted to uphold the ACA and introduced Medicare-X, a public option that expands on the Affordable Care Act by offering families, individuals, and small businesses more low-cost health insurance choices and creating competition in the marketplace. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Hung Cao opposed funding for Ukraine and denigrated NATO.
Tim Kaine introduced and passed bipartisan legislation to prevent any president from unilaterally withdrawing from NATO, because it’s an alliance that’s foundational to our national security. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Oh, and by the way: Hung Cao thinks witchcraft is a problem that he needs to tackle to make sure it doesn’t “happen in Virginia.”
...Yeah, we don’t have anything on that. Tim Kaine likes Halloween, though. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]

**And then, the extremists who've gerrymandered their way into office pass more voter suppression bills, making it even harder for voters to cast their ballots with each election year.**

| | Today marks one year since the worst mass murder of Jews in a single day since the Holocaust. The deliberate slaughter of over a thousand innocent men, women, and children shocked us all. Today, we remember the lives lost, the families torn apart, and the communities forever scarred by this evil. We stand in solidarity with those who lost loved ones, and with those whose relatives were taken hostage. We honor the resilience and bravery of the Jewish people, who have withstood persecution for centuries and have stood tall in the face of terror, defending their homes, their families, and their country. We must continue to support Israel’s right to defend itself and work tirelessly to ensure that those responsible for these horrific acts are held accountable and that every remaining hostage is brought home safely. We must also ensure that Jewish Americans are safe from the scourge of antisemitism that has risen precipitously in the days and months since that awful attack. May the memories of the victims be a blessing, and may their families find strength in the unwavering support of those who stand with them.

October 7, 2024
Dr. Michael Goldstein, the Republican nominee for the Fourth Congressional District in Connecticut and his Democratic opponent Jim Himes were invited to speak and take questions at Temple Sinai, a Reform Synagogue in Stamford, Connecticut. Both attended.
But only one candidate was booed before he opened his mouth. That candidate was Dr. Goldstein.
Dr. Goldstein does not wear his faith on his sleeve, but he is a member of a synagogue in Greenwich. His charming wife Belle's father was shot in the leg fighting the Nazis in Poland. He removed the bullet with his penknife. Her mother and two aunts survived concentration camps and all thrived when they immigrated to America after the war. So naturally Dr. Goldstein and his family are more attuned to antisemitism and Israel's survival than most people.
But Dr. Goldstein is a Republican who supports the nominee of the Republican Party, Donald Trump. And if polls and the behavior of the congregants of Temple Sinai is any indication, at least two-thirds of the Jewish vote will go to these Democratic nominees.
This may have seemed reasonable in the past as Jewish voters tend to be more liberal than the general population, but things have changed. Jewish voters who believe Israeli's survival to be paramount should consider the following:
President Trump moved the American Embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem as promised during his campaign. Previous presidents who made the same promise reneged. In fact, the area where the embassy is enclosed is now called Trump Square.
President Trump instituted sanctions on Iranian oil exports with the hope their government would not longer fund Israeli's enemies. It worked. Iran's foreign reserves fell from $120 billion to $4 billion and there was a chance the Ayatollah would be overthrown. There were no attacks on Israel during his presidency.
President Trump's Abraham accords were yielding progress in securing Middle East peace. [Henry Kissinger was amazed](https://substack.com/redirect/96f7597f-7a8b-42d4-b06f-f015157de15e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at Trump's success.
President Trump has Jewish grandchildren.
President Biden discontinued the negotiations of the Abraham accords and lifted the sanctions on Iran. Congressman Himes supported this policy.
Iran was able to fund Hamas who then launched a terrorist attack against Israel, killing over 1,200 Israelis, videotaping the raping of Israeli women, killing babies and taking hostages.
Israel launched an invasion into Gaza to stop Hamas.
Antisemitic riots then occurred at leading liberal elite universities. The presidents of MIT, Harvard and UPenn all stated to Congress that students advocating the genocide of Jews were covered by free speech. The Independent candidate, [Ben Wesley](https://substack.com/redirect/fdde7d12-66c4-4a93-bfaf-4a75a9974e11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), against both Himes and Goldstein in this race believes Israel is committing genocide in Gaza and has been [endorsed](https://substack.com/redirect/f27daa56-73a6-4edd-b0e5-2e0bc07fb71d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by [Justice for Palestine in Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/ae7be947-083d-485d-aac9-739c860b467e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/864464b8-64f6-42ab-832d-400fe1b0a5ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/61016332-2c4d-4e2f-9550-824c5866d3ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Democratic Candidate Congressman Jim Himes
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/741707c0-6aec-4384-bdc1-842fd9da101a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Independent Candidate Ben Wesley
Jewish students at Columbia University were told not to wear Yarmulkes or the Star of David. Nonetheless, Jewish students were attacked by other students. Some were arrested but Manhattan district Attorney (a Democrat) dropped the charges.
Hezbollah and Iran have now bombed Israel, who is now fighting a war on three fronts.
Iran is much closer to developing nuclear weapons.
President Biden and Democratic nominee Kamala Harris are trying to bully Prime Minister Netanyahu into calling a cease fire even though none of Israeli's enemies plan to stop their attacks or release any hostages. [Harris will not even call Netanyahu an ally!](https://substack.com/redirect/56c8054c-0b93-428e-afb5-7cf732667156?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Antisemitic incidents have [skyrocketed in Europe and the United States.](https://substack.com/redirect/36ed6232-fdfc-4a1f-b452-38084d8d27d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 65% of hate crimes in the United States are committed against Jewish people yet only 2% of the population is Jewish!
For many Jewish voters, especially women, the composition of the Supreme Court especially with regards to abortion rights is a major issue. But is Israel's survival also important? Given the respective records of the Trump and Biden/Harris administration, who will fight for Israel and against antisemitism?
Clearly it is President Trump along with Dr. Michael Goldstein. Israel has not had a better friend in the White House in President Trump since Harry Truman.
Perhaps Jewish voters believe that Harris and the Democrats are tolerating antisemitism and demanding an Israeli ceasefire as a ploy to keep Arab voters in the Democratic fold, especially in the swing state of Michigan. Perhaps they believe that after the election, Democratic support for Israel will increase and antisemitism will be prosecuted. Perhaps they are right.
Perhaps.
But will Israel be around in fifty years?
Jews living in Israel have gotten the message and support President Trump over Kamala Harris by [54% to 24%.](https://substack.com/redirect/59134350-5ab6-424e-8860-7f1d4d17e6bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And American Jews will have to decide who their real friends are, Trump and Goldstein or Harris and Himes.

Peter,
During my debate against Democrat Tim Kaine, I was asked a question that hit close to home. As an immigrant, do I support mass deportations? My answer is deeply personal. Immigration isn’t just a political issue for me—it’s part of who I am. When I was just four years old and Vietnam fell to the communists, my family had nowhere to go. But America welcomed us. My parents waited in line for seven years to become American citizens. The last thing my father had hanging above his bed when he passed away two years ago was his naturalization certificate. I love this country with everything I have. I proved it by writing a blank check, up to and including my life, serving in the Navy for 25 years in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia to defend our freedoms. Here’s what I have to say to anyone who wants to come to America: Don’t ask for the American Dream unless you’re willing to respect American laws and embrace American values—because that’s what I did. And yet, under the Biden-Kamala-Kaine watch, we just learned that 13,000 convicted murderers and 16,000 convicted rapists have entered our country. This is unacceptable. The current administration has stripped away our core values, leading us down a dangerous path toward a dark future. But it’s not too late to turn things around. Peter, I’m humbly asking you to help fuel my fight. This is going to be one of the most important races in the nation, and control of the Senate **WILL** come down to this race. clean_body: This is hard to admit| | | Peter, During my debate against Democrat Tim Kaine, I was asked a question that hit close to home. As an immigrant, do I support mass deportations? My answer is deeply personal. Immigration isn’t just a political issue for me—it’s part of who I am. When I was just four years old and Vietnam fell to the communists, my family had nowhere to go. But America welcomed us. My parents waited in line for seven years to become American citizens. The last thing my father had hanging above his bed when he passed away two years ago was his naturalization certificate. I love this country with everything I have. I proved it by writing a blank check, up to and including my life, serving in the Navy for 25 years in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia to defend our freedoms. Here’s what I have to say to anyone who wants to come to America: Don’t ask for the American Dream unless you’re willing to respect American laws and embrace American values—because that’s what I did. And yet, under the Biden-Kamala-Kaine watch, we just learned that 13,000 convicted murderers and 16,000 convicted rapists have entered our country. This is unacceptable. The current administration has stripped away our core values, leading us down a dangerous path toward a dark future. But it’s not too late to turn things around. Peter, I’m humbly asking you to help fuel my fight. This is going to be one of the most important races in the nation, and control of the Senate WILL come down to this race. If you’re going to give $5 or $10 this election cycle—make it count, make it right now. Together, we can bring America back to greatness—before the Democrats push us further down this dark path. I’m not done fighting for us. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.
